dedupe_keys.name: annual shoreline positions of england and wales 1999 2020

description: The Zenodo dataset gives annual coastline positions for England and Wales from 1999 to 2020. Its authors used CoastSat and tidal correction to extract positions across 276 regions of interest, with transects spaced at about 10 m. The public release includes a region-classification workbook, transect GeoJSON, coastline positions as distances, coordinates and GeoJSON, a tide-conversion note, and modified extraction code. Coastal-defence, port and road exposure simulations can compare historical shoreline movement with asset locations or check shoreline-change model output. Validation was performed only for sandy beaches, although the release includes other shoreline types. Clouds, shoreline classification, tidal correction and local imagery can affect a position; annual samples do not describe storm-time retreat. The article cites concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16874822; Zenodo resolves it to the current version, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21888597. The own page marks this version open under CC BY 4.0 with no charge stated. No ZIP was downloaded, so individual transect geometries were not checked. It complements the catalogue's French Cerema coastal-erosion indicator by providing repeated English and Welsh transect positions, not a national change class.
name: Annual shoreline positions of England and Wales, 1999–2020
notes: G3 G3-0650. Draft only. No resource files downloaded or software executed. The article cites the concept DOI; Zenodo's API redirected that DOI to version 21888597. Its attached CoastSat script is part of this dataset, not separately catalogued software. Article and current Zenodo state 1999–2020.
